chapter: Chapter 6 — Measuring What Matters: From Telemetry to Architecture Decisions
evidence:

rps · token profile · concurrency". Caption: "Figure-art note: the third printed entry in the workload box (concurrency) is an erratum in the figure art for the offered request rate λ; it is not a workload metric."
